@timestamp date
agent.keyword string
bytes number

phpmemory number

timestamp date

url.keyword string
utc_time date
hour_of_day number
  /api/dashboards:
    get:
      description: Returns a paginated list of dashboards. Each result includes title, description, tags, and metadata, but not the full panel layout. Use `GET /api/dashboards/{id}` to retrieve the complete state.
      operationId: get-dashboards
      parameters:
        - description: The page of results to return.
          in: query
          name: page
          required: false
          schema:
            default: 1
            minimum: 1
            type: number
        - description: The number of results to return per page.
          in: query
          name: per_page
          required: false
          schema:
            default: 20
            maximum: 1000
            minimum: 1
            type: number
        - description: Filters results by `title` and `description` using Elasticsearch [`simple_query_string`](https://www.elastic.co/docs/reference/query-languages/query-dsl/query-dsl-simple-query-string-query) syntax. Multi-word terms require all words to match.
          in: query
          name: query
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
        - description: A tag ID to include. Accepts a single tag ID or multiple tag IDs. When multiple are specified, library items matching any of the tag IDs are included.
          in: query
          name: tags
          required: false
          schema:
            default: []
            description: Tag IDs associated with this dashboard.
            items:
              maxLength: 250
              type: string
            maxItems: 100
            type: array
        - description: A tag ID to exclude. Accepts a single tag ID or multiple tag IDs. When multiple are specified, library items matching any of the tag IDs are excluded.
          in: query
          name: excluded_tags
          required: false
          schema:
            default: []
            description: Tag IDs associated with this dashboard.
            items:
              maxLength: 250
              type: string
            maxItems: 100
            type: array
        - description: A tag name to include. Accepts a single tag name or multiple tag names. When multiple are specified, library items matching any of the tag names are included. If the same name is shared by multiple tags, items matching any of those tags are included.
          in: query
          name: tag_names
          required: false
          schema:
            items:
              type: string
            maxItems: 100
            type: array
            x-state: Generally available; added in 9.6.0
        - description: A tag name to exclude. Accepts a single tag name or multiple tag names. When multiple are specified, library items matching any of the tag names are excluded. If the same name is shared by multiple tags, items matching any of those tags are excluded.
          in: query
          name: excluded_tag_names
          required: false
          schema:
            items:
              type: string
            maxItems: 100
            type: array
            x-state: Generally available; added in 9.6.0
      responses:
        '200':
          content:
            application/json:
              examples:
                searchDashboardsResponse:
                  description: |
                    Paginated list of dashboard summaries. Each item includes the ID, a subset of dashboard state fields (`title`, `time_range` if set), and metadata. Full panel content is not included - use the GET endpoint to retrieve a specific dashboard.
                  summary: Search dashboards response
                  value:
                    data:
                      - data:
                          title: Web logs overview
                        id: 3c4b8e10-d57a-11ef-9a52-4f3c2a8d0e1b
                        meta:
                          created_at: '2026-04-13T10:00:00.000Z'
                          managed: false
                          updated_at: '2026-04-13T10:00:00.000Z'
                          version: WzEwMiwxXQ==
                      - data:
                          time_range:
                            from: now-7d
                            to: now
                          title: Operations overview
                        id: 7f2a1c40-e83b-11ef-a641-7d5b3f9e1c2a
                        meta:
                          created_at: '2026-04-12T08:00:00.000Z'
                          managed: false
                          updated_at: '2026-04-12T14:22:00.000Z'
                          version: WzEwMSwxXQ==
                    meta:
                      page: 1
                      per_page: 20

post:
      description: Creates a new dashboard and returns its ID, full state, and metadata.
      operationId: post-dashboards
      parameters:
        - description: A required header to protect against CSRF attacks
          in: header
          name: kbn-xsrf
          required: true
          schema:
            example: 'true'
            type: string
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/Kibana_HTTP_APIs_kbn-dashboard-data'
      responses:
        '201':
          content:
            application/json:
              examples:
                createDashboardResponse:
                  description: |
                    Response to creating a dashboard. Returns the generated ID, the full dashboard state in `data`, and metadata. Default option values are always returned even when not explicitly set in the request. Pan
                  summary: Create dashboard response
                  value:
                    data:
                      access_control:
                        access_mode: write_restricted
                      options:
                        auto_apply_filters: true
                        hide_panel_borders: false
                        hide_panel_titles: false
                        sync_colors: false
                        sync_cursor: true
                        sync_tooltips: false
                        use_margins: true
                      panels:
                        - config:
                            content: '## Web logs overview'
                          grid:
                            h: 15
                            w: 24
                            x: 0
                            'y': 0
                          id: a1b2c3d4-0001-4000-8000-000000000001
                          type: markdown
                        - config:
                            data_source:
                              index_pattern: kibana_sample_data_logs
                              time_field: timestamp
                              type: data_view_spec
                            ignore_global_filters: false
                            metrics:
                              - empty_as_null: false
                                operation: count
                                type: primary
                            sampling: 1
                            styling:
                              primary:
                                labels:
                                  alignment: left
                                position: bottom
                                value:
                                  alignment: right
                                  sizing: auto
                            title: ''
                            type: metric
                          grid:
                            h: 5
                            w: 12
                            x: 24
                            'y': 0
                          id: a1b2c3d4-0001-4000-8000-000000000002
                          type: vis
                        - config:
                            data_source:
                              index_pattern: kibana_sample_data_logs
                              time_field: timestamp
                              type: data_view_spec
                            ignore_global_filters: false
                            metrics:
                              - field: bytes
                                operation: average
                                type: primary
                            sampling: 1
                            styling:
                              primary:
                                labels:
                                  alignment: left
                                position: bottom
                                value:
                                  alignment: right
                                  sizing: auto
                            title: ''
                            type: metric
                          grid:
                            h: 5
                            w: 12
                            x: 36
                            'y': 0
                          id: a1b2c3d4-0001-4000-8000-000000000003
                          type: vis
                        - config:
                            axis:
                              x:
                                domain:
                                  rounding: false
                                  type: fit
                                grid:
                                  visible: true
                                labels:
                                  orientation: horizontal
                                scale: ordinal
                                ticks:
                                  visible: true
                                title:
                                  visible: false
                              'y':

                                  rounding: true
                                  type: full

                                  visible: true

                                  visible: true
                                title:
                                  visible: true

content.text:
The dashboard and the alert rule both exist now. I haven't opened the dashboard in Kibana to check how it renders, and the rule has not run yet.

**Data:** The sample logs hold web requests. The fields I used are `timestamp`, `bytes`, `response.keyword` (the HTTP status code) and `clientip`. There are also `extension`, `geo.*`, `machine.os`, `agent`, `request`, `url` and `referer`.

**Dashboard:** "EFF-f89f0e35 Web logs overview" (id `469314a4-3c0d-41c8-ba71-cfc7f219c9cc`) has three panels and a default range of the last 7 days:
- Total requests, a count metric.
- Avg bytes, an average of `bytes`.
- Requests over time, a line chart of request count against `timestamp`.

My first attempt at the line chart used an ES|QL data source, and Kibana rejected it as invalid. I rebuilt it on the data view and Kibana accepted that.

**Rule:** "EFF-f89f0e35 5xx spike" (id `261a50f8-8374-454c-b005-3d4e8212c2a5`) is an Elasticsearch query rule on `kibana_sample_data_logs`.
- **Schedule:** it checks every 1 minute.
- **Condition:** it fires when more than 10 documents match a regexp on `response.keyword` (`5[0-9][0-9]`) within a 5-minute window.
- **Actions:** none are attached, so a firing will only show up as an alert in Kibana. It won't send a notification.
- **Possible mismatch with your wording:** Kibana defaulted `excludeHitsFromPreviousRun` to `true`. Documents already counted in an earlier run don't count again. That is not a strict 5-minute rolling count. If you want one, I can set it to `false`.

One slip: an early command of mine hung on empty input and timed out. It created no objects.
